title: eludite/solution/tree
description: The projects of the open solution and their source files, from the host's MSBuild evaluation (SDK-style and legacy projects alike). Feeds Workspace. Computed once per generation, in the background; the request may be sent right after eludite/solution/open and is answered when the evaluation finishes.

params.description: No params: omitted, null, or an empty object/array.

generation.description: The solution generation the tree was computed under (see host-rpc.md). The shell drops a tree whose generation is no longer current.

path.description: Absolute path of the open .sln, .slnx or project file; null when no solution is open (projects is then empty).

name.description: Project file name without extension, as Workspace shows it.

path.description: Absolute path of the project file.

kind.description: sdk: an SDK-style project. legacy: a non-SDK (MSBuild 2003) project, evaluated as in brief 0003.

web.description: True for web projects (Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web, a WebForms or MVC project type, or WebForms markup items); their content files are listed.

targetFrameworks.description: Short target framework monikers, for example ["net10.0"], ["net8.0", "net10.0"] or ["net48"]. Empty when evaluation failed.

files.description: Compile items, plus Content items for web projects, as absolute paths in evaluation order.

error.description: Why the project could not be evaluated; files is then empty. Workspace shows the project as unavailable.

dependencies.description: Visual Studio's Dependencies node (brief 0048): Packages, Projects and Frameworks, from the evaluation and the assets file; read from disk only (nothing contacts a source).

restored.description: project.assets.json was read; without it packages are the PackageReference items as written.

requested.description: As the project file (or Directory.Packages.props) writes it.

autoReferenced.description: An implicit reference of the SDK.

transitive.description: The packages it brings in (its dependencies in the assets file), shown when its node is expanded.

vulnerabilities.description: NuGet Audit's warnings (NU1901 to NU1904) the last restore wrote for this package.

items.description: A known vulnerability of this version, from the source's registration data (or NuGet Audit's NU1901 to NU1904 warnings in the assets file).

severity.description: The advisory's severity (NuGet's 0 low, 1 moderate, 2 high, 3 critical).

advisoryUrl.description: The advisory's address (a GitHub advisory for nuget.org).

deprecated.description: The last answer from the sources said this version is deprecated (not known until the Manage NuGet Packages window or an agent asked).

frameworks.description: Shared frameworks (FrameworkReference items and the SDK's implicit one).

dependentUpon.description: Absolute path of the file this one nests under (DependentUpon metadata), when set.

link.description: The Link metadata (project-relative display path) for a file outside the project directory, when set.
